exposure: Acid base and blood gas analysis
cohort: The study included 24 neonates with FGR and 124 control neonates without FGR, admitted to a NICU, born at 33 to 36 6/7 gestational weeks.
finding: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) was found to reduce the probability of early neonatal hypocalcemia, while cesarean delivery was found to increase it in moderate and late preterm neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to increase the probability of early neonatal hypocalcemia by 2.702 times.
